en: Sepia-toned landscape view taken from an elevated terrace with a wooden gazebo and railing in the foreground and the wall of a large building (likely a castle) on the right. Below, a small town with clustered houses lies in a valley surrounded by wooded hills and fields. Leaves and branches partly frame the image at the top. Printed caption text in German runs along the bottom edge.
